shots.purpose: Show a plugin bundle assembling into coordinated capabilities
shots.prompt: Keep the camera almost locked with a very slow three-percent push forward. Animate the central modular core opening once while its six existing capability modules illuminate clockwise and the existing cool-white connection paths carry one restrained electric-blue to violet energy trace. Preserve every module, platform, path, object position, crop, dark navy palette, negative space, and the single soft-pink endpoint. Begin exactly from the supplied still and settle cleanly. Do not add text, logos, symbols, people, modules, particles, camera roll, flicker, warping, morphing, or abrupt motion.
shots.camera: nearly locked with a slow three-percent forward push
shots.continuityNotes: Preserve all module positions, right-side negative space, the central core, and the blue-violet-pink hierarchy.

Preserve every gate, package, rail, desk, object position, geometry, crop, dark negative space, and palette. Begin exactly from the supplied still and settle at the final workspace.
